summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 32 yen per share from 28 yen, and full-year dividend forecast revised upward to 64 yen per share from 58 yen, representing 4 yen and 6 yen increases respectively for fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase in Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Koito Manufacturing announced an increase in interim dividend to 32 yen per share, up 4 yen from the previous forecast of 28 yen for the fiscal year ending March 2027, with a record date of September 30, 2026 and payable date of December 4, 2026. The total dividend payout for the interim period amounts to 8,198 million yen. Concurrently, the company revised its full-year dividend forecast upward by 6 yen to 64 yen per share, with the year-end dividend prediction raised to 32 yen, an increase of 2 yen from the prior guidance of 30 yen.

The company's stated rationale reflects its commitment to sustainable growth through business investments that enhance corporate value, combined with a priority to strengthen shareholder returns. The dividend increases are based on comprehensive consideration of current-period financial performance and the operating environment, consistent with the company's fundamental policy of maintaining stable and sustainable dividend payments. The previous full-year forecast issued on July 29, 2026 had projected 58 yen per share.
